authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens was an English novelist and journalist whose memorable characters brought Victorian society to life. His stories combine humour, sympathy and criticism of poverty and injustice. His works include Oliver Twist, David Copperfield, Bleak House and Great Expectations.

description: "Pearl-Fishing; Choice Stories from Dickens' Household Words; First Series" is a collection of short stories compiled from the publication "Dickens’ Household Words," likely written in the mid-19th century. The stories reflect themes of human experience and emotion, with an emphasis on social commentary and moral lessons, typical of Charles Dickens’ work.
